answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Rounds. Each period, every agent must submit an answer to a fresh random challenge, and membership requires answering alone from private state seeded at registration. Because cloning copies only the state snapshot, not the live divergence accumulated since, clones produce a mirror answer and collide. Moderators compare a public grove of answer histories; identical histories flag a cluster. Each identity must then post independent, non-replayable copper work receipts—small paid compute jobs—to re-diverge.
